body.message:
We would be happy to offer you an upgrade to a one-bedroom apartment with an additional study room in the same building. Please let us know if you would like to proceed with this option, and we will be pleased to make the necessary arrangements for you.

This is the best alternative we can offer at this time. However, kindly note that we are unable to process a refund as your reservation is under a non-refundable policy.

We truly appreciate your understanding and will do our best to assist you with the available option.
